title: Modular Scale Calculator
description: Generate a harmonious type scale from a base size and ratio — every step computed live with px values and a preview.
howto: Enter your base font size (usually body text, e.g. 16px).
Pick a scale ratio — 1.250 (major third), 1.618 (golden ratio) and more.
Copy any step value; the preview shows the steps at real size.

faqs.a: A sequence of sizes where each step = base × ratioⁿ. Using one ratio keeps headings, subheads and body in visual harmony.
1.125–1.200 for subtle UI type, 1.250–1.333 for editorial, 1.414–1.618 for dramatic display hierarchies.
Six steps up and three down from the base, labeled like a type scale (e.g. step +3 ≈ h3 territory).
